text: Let’s import prepare data. ’ll use example dataset GSE189410 demonstrate workflow:

title: RNA-seq Analysis Guide
text: run_deseq2_pip() function wrapper function runs complete RNA-seq analysis every PAIRWISE ONE--comparison pairs specified group variable. analysis comparison pair can broken three modules: Quality Control: Filters genes, generates QC/PCA/distance plots, saves expression data run_qc_pip() run_dist_pip() Differential Expression Analysis: Performs DESeq2 analysis, functional gene annotation, creates volcano plots run_diffexp_pip() plot_peak_annot_pip() (ATAC-seq ) GSEA Analysis: Find enriched pathways using MSigDB collections prepare results EnrichmentMap visualization run_gsea_pip() run_enrichmentmap_pip() example dataset, 3 comparison pairs group variable Group2: IgM vs IgG, IgM vs IgA, IgG vs IgA. ’s run complete pipeline single command: Note: Repeating run_deseq2_pip overwrite existing files directory name used. prevent , please specify different save_dir directory.

title: RNA-seq Analysis Guide
text: initial run DESeq2 pipeline, may wish run specific module using different parameters comparison groups without repeating entire pipeline. ’s run module separately. First, set global arguments. commands run individual module:
